description: This file defines Flask routes for the admin section of a library management system, handling admin login, logout, user and book management, and search functionality.

methods.name: home
methods.description: Handles the admin home page, setting session and rendering the admin home template.

methods.name: signin
methods.description: Handles admin sign-in, validating credentials and setting session.

methods.name: signout
methods.description: Logs out the admin and redirects to the admin login page.

methods.name: users_view
methods.description: Displays the list of users for the admin.

methods.name: books
methods.description: Displays the list of books available.

methods.name: view_book
methods.description: Displays details of a specific book and its owners.

methods.name: book_add
methods.description: Renders the page to add a new book.

methods.name: book_edit
methods.description: Renders the page to edit an existing book.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for books based on a keyword.
